text: Rapamycin (sirolimus) functions as a potent immunosuppressant by forming a complex with the intracellular protein FKBP12, which then binds to and allosterically inhibits the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) kinase. By inhibiting the mTORC1 signaling pathway, rapamycin blocks T-cell proliferation and cytokine-driven cell cycle progression, thereby preventing the immune-mediated rejection of transplanted renal tissue.
